sourceSpeakingEnglish: Role-play Dos lugares para estudiar with a patient classmate. Practice comparisons. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

cards.proposalNote: Est can express identity, condition or location in French.
The same French form est can describe a condition or location: le café est moins loin que l’école.
La can be an article or an object pronoun, depending on syntax.
Pour + noun means for (pour les débutants); pour + infinitive can mean in order to (pour étudier).

candidateGrammar.explanation: Place plus or moins before an adjective or adverb, then que before the second thing: la bibliothèque est plus calme que le café; le café est moins loin que l’école. For equality, use aussi + adjective + que: cette table est aussi grande que celle-là. Meilleur describes a better book or place: mon livre est meilleur pour les débutants. Grande takes -e to agree with table.

candidateSpeaking.prompt: Role-play choosing two places to study with a patient classmate. Say that the library is quieter than the café and that the café is less far away than the school. Compare two tables and a book for beginners. Ask which place is better for studying, answer your partner, and confirm understanding. Keep to beginner French; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

sourceConflict.cards4And5: Spanish es is identity and está is condition/location; proposed French est is identical on both cards, so the ordinary two-column card face loses the contrast and must not be scored as two distinct French prompts.
sourceConflict.card7: French la may be article or object pronoun; source English groups the senses and this lesson has no local pronoun example.
sourceConflict.card8: French pour maps to for/in order to in different syntactic contexts.
sourceConflict.objective: The canonical source objective is truncated as Comparisons: Use más .; the complete source sentences support comparisons, but curriculum repair requires a source decision.
